data.change_summary: Implemented the pending shrimp stage-model amendments in the current workspace: `AnimalState::add_reserve_by_feeding_units()` now uses the adult feeding weight constant consistently; shrimp preset/scenario materialization now carries the stage-aware runtime knobs instead of defaulting them away, while preserving legacy scenario maturation tuning by splitting `process_params.shrimp_juvenile_maturation_days` into juvenile/sub-adult stage durations; v4->v5 save migration now seeds those stage durations from the legacy total-days field so older saves keep their prior maturation schedule; and load-time invariant enforcement now validates `ShrimpRuntimeParams`, with regression coverage for migration, scenario materialization, direct-load rejection of invalid stage params, and the updated thermal reproduction test contract.
outstanding_risks: Scenario compatibility still infers a 60/40 juvenile/sub-adult split from the documented 30+20 default stage contract whenever only the legacy total maturation-days knob is available; any future preset that needs a different split must set explicit stage durations.

Direct callers that build `TankState` programmatically still need to write `state.shrimp_params` or call `apply_legacy_total_maturation_days()` themselves; the legacy `process_params.shrimp_juvenile_maturation_days` field is only translated during scenario materialization and v4->v5 save migration.
Focused tank_core, tank_data, and tank_scenarios suites passed, but I did not rerun the broader end-to-end/UI/harness matrix in this amendment pass.

steps.description: Inspect the shrimp biology weighting, preset/scenario materialization, save migration, and invariant validation paths behind the pending amendments.

Patch the runtime and preset wiring so stage-aware shrimp params are materialized explicitly, legacy maturation totals split into stage durations for scenarios and migrated saves, and the adult reserve-routing weight matches `feeding_units()` semantics.

Add load-time validation for `ShrimpRuntimeParams` and update regression coverage for scenario materialization, v4->v5 migration, invalid current-schema loads, and the thermal reproduction maturation override path.
Format the touched code and run focused validation across tank_core, tank_data, and tank_scenarios.
